input.quote: 10.7 Entire Agreement. This Agreement is the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, superseding any prior agreements and communications (both written and oral) regarding such subject matter.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant of any kind. Searches for "solicit", "employ/engage/hire", "induce", "recruit" and "personnel" return nothing, and a full read of the operative sections confirms it: the only restrictive covenants are the exclusivity provisions in Section 6 (Company not to participate in similar projects; HDI not to do so for two years) and the mutual confidentiality obligations in Section 8, none of which touch hiring or soliciting employees. Section 10.2 confirms the parties are independent contractors and neither is the other's employee, and the integration clause in Section 10.7 makes this the complete and exclusive agreement, so no personnel covenant is imported from elsewhere. The Company (our client) is therefore under no non-solicitation restriction, which meets the preferred position exactly; no redline is warranted.
